@TheCruZ I ran your amd-diag build (098b5fd) on an RX 9070 XT, Windows 11, with UFC 6 (PPSA23566). It's not GTA, but it may help with the AMD issues.

**Driver 26.8.1:** crashes inside `vkCreateComputePipelines` (null write inside the driver, same offset on every run, also with `--no-async-pipelines --gpu-pipeline 0`).

**Driver 26.9.2 (optional):** that crash is gone and the game gets much further (VS 72 | PS 84 | CS 121). Shortly after BDA is enabled, the GPU is lost:

```
GPU: using buffer device address (BDA) shader memory access.
vkQueueSubmit failed: ErrorDeviceLost (-4), tick=28186 debug_op=0 debug_submit=14568 args=60,2160,1,65,0x00000011604c8000
Not implemented (result != vk::Result::eSuccess) in commandScheduler.cpp:548
```

- Deterministic: two separate runs show identical `args=60,2160,1,65,0x00000011604c8000`. The 60×2160×1 might be a full-resolution 4K compute dispatch, but that's only a guess.
- Launched from the launcher, the hang took down the whole system (black screen, hard reboot). Launched from the command line, Windows recovered and only the emulator exited.
- The depth-copy path works: no feedback-loop exit. I get the same results with #1187.
- With Vulkan validation on, this build exits early on the amd-diag BC5 probe (`vkCreateImage ... VK_ERROR_FORMAT_NOT_SUPPORTED`, vulkanWindow.cpp:840), so validation can't be used to chase the device lost.

The full log (26.9.2, validation off) is attached. I'm happy to test any build.
